unresolved_forms.en: the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ
unresolved_forms.ar: رِجَالًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ

unresolved_forms.en: Muhammad b. Mansur b. Abi Sulayman al-Balkhi, Muhammad b. 'Isa, and Yazid al-Tusi
unresolved_forms.ar: مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ الْبَلْخِيِّ
ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْهُمَا
جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْهُ

unresolved_forms.en: a man of Thaqif, said to be al-Hakam or Ibn al-Hakam
unresolved_forms.ar: رَجُلٍ مِنْ ثَقِيفٍ يُقَالُ: الْحَكَمُ أَوِ ابْنُ الْحَكَمِ
يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ

unresolved_forms.en: Ibn Abi al-Sab' b. Talha said
[A question] concerning the sick person whose mind has gone: how is he dealt with at the time of prayer? So he wrote to me informing me: From Muhammad b. al-Munkadir
Jabir b. al-Aswad or al-Aswad b. Jabir
unresolved_forms.ar: جَابِرٍ بْنِ الْأَسْوَدِ أَوِ الْأَسْوَدِ بْنِ جَابِرٍ

unresolved_forms.en: And Mansur and Muhammad b. Bishr, all of them
Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Isma'il al-Kufi
unresolved_forms.ar: أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ الْكُوفِيُّ

unresolved_forms.en: a man of the people of Syria
Abu al-Sawwar, who is also called Abu al-Sawda', and he is al-Sulami
unresolved_forms.ar: أَبِي السَّوَّارِ وَيُقَالُ أَبُو السَّوْدَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّلْمِيُّ

unresolved_forms.en: a shaykh from the people of Medina

unresolved_forms.ar: نَاصِحِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَيُقَالُ: ابْنُ عَجْلَانَ

unresolved_forms.en: Isma'il b. Hammad, and his father, and al-Qasim b. Ma'n, and 'Abd al-Malik
one whom I do not suspect

unresolved_forms.ar: حَبَّةَ الْعُرَنِيِّ وَهُوَ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ عَلِيٍّ كَرَّمَ اللَّهُ وَجْهَهُ

unresolved_forms.en: Ziyad, raising it to the Prophet ﷺ
